bok.text: General Takeno exhorts his soldiers to "die as a hero," and he scolds the imperial mapmaker for arriving at the battlefield too late again, as Konda orders him to find Isao, who claims no allegiance.
When Hidetsugu's forces attack, O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half at Eiganjo and Takeno dies protecting Konda.
An army of twisted ghosts led by a misshapen Takeno then rises to aid Konda while Isamaru and the wounded Yosei rally the soldiers.

jmp.text: In Jumpstart, General Takeno's hound Isamaru senses the coming kami, and Takeno calms him with a touch and orders the guard alerted.

j22.text: In Jumpstart 2022, General Takeno is the Kamigawan general who keeps the hound Isamaru, and Michiko leaves home vowing not to return until she can restore her father and Kamigawa's peace.
